serverInfo.name: A-Pay Protocol MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Universal Micropayment & Autonomous Economic Settlement Engine for AI Agents on Base L2.

extensions.description: SealKeeper SEAL, Signed Evidence of Agent Legitimacy. GET params.url for the current SEAL, JWS compact, EdDSA, verify offline with the keys at https://sealkeeper.run/.well-known/seal.json

tools.name: apay_request
tools.description: Make an HTTP request (GET, POST, etc.) to any API or website. If the endpoint returns an HTTP 402 Payment Required challenge, A-Pay automatically signs the cryptographic payment authorization within your budget limits and unlocks the data in <25ms.

url.description: Target endpoint URL to fetch or query with HTTP 402 payment support (e.g. "https://api.example.com/v1/market-data" or "https://apayprotocol.org/api/ping").

method.description: HTTP request method to execute against the target URL (default: "GET"). Allowed values: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE.

json_body.description: Optional JSON payload object for POST or PUT requests (e.g. {"query": "ETH-USD", "limit": 10}).

headers.description: Optional additional HTTP request headers as key-value pairs (e.g. {"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": "APayAgent/1.0"}).

tools.name: apay_get_wallet_status
tools.description: Inspect the agent's active non-custodial wallet address, network, current spending guardrails, and total spent in USDC and $APAY.

tools.name: apay_set_budget
tools.description: Configure agent safety invariants and spending guardrails. Prevents runaway loops or overcharging.

max_per_call_usdc.description: Maximum USDC allowance for a single API call (e.g. 0.05).

max_per_call_apay.description: Maximum $APAY token allowance for a single API call (e.g. 10.0).

tools.name: apay_inspect_endpoint
tools.description: Inspect an endpoint to check if it requires an A-Pay micropayment, inspect the exact price quote, currency, and payout receiver without spending any funds.

url.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL to probe for HTTP 402 payment requirements (e.g. "https://api.example.com/premium-feed").

tools.name: apay_get_balance
tools.description: Inspect the agent's live on-chain balances on Base Layer 2, including native ETH (for gas), USDC, and $APAY tokens.

address.description: Optional EVM address to inspect balances for (e.g. "0x5eC06f4219C6b44CfE7c91463dD65B7B8E0fbEfc"). Defaults to active protocol treasury/wallet if omitted.
